articles.title: Accounting For Tidal Deformability In Binary Neutron Star Template Banks Improves Sensitivity Near Detection Thresholds, Reducing Losses By 33% And 8.2%
articles.description: Researchers demonstrate that incorporating the subtle distortions of neutron stars caused by gravity into the search for gravitational waves significantly improves the detection of binary neutron star systems, requiring a more comprehensive exploration of potential signals than current methods allow.
